scope: Independent verification of build-impact placement evidence, executable and input identity, report outcomes and artifact bytes. Shader source authored by this reviewer is excluded from independent source-review claims.
evidence_execution: Read existing immutable results and recomputed every referenced SHA256 and size. GPU execution was performed by the parent agent; this review reran no GPU workload.
